metadata.title: 博通 AI 单季 167 亿美元：定制芯片把利润留给谁？
metadata.titleEn: Broadcom’s $16.7 Billion AI Quarter: Who Keeps the Custom-Silicon Profit?
metadata.summary: AI 收入加速并不等于 GPU 份额被等额替代。拆开博通毛利率与利润美元额、云客户现金支出，以及 HBM、网络、电力和验收约束，才能看清定制芯片如何重分基础设施利润。
metadata.summaryEn: AI growth is not a dollar-for-dollar transfer of GPU market share. Broadcom’s margins, customer cash spending and the gates between HBM and energized racks reveal how custom silicon can redistribute infrastructure profits.
